subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the woman based on <Picture 2>, featuring long blonde wavy hair, a black ribbed turtleneck sweater, grey tailored trousers, and a minimalist aesthetic.
<Subject 2> is the coral lipstick carton visible in <Picture 1>, a small, vibrant red-orange packaging box being held by <Subject 1>.
<Video 1> is the primary visual reference, depicting a bathroom scene with a black granite sink, white subway tiles, a stainless steel faucet, and a smartphone resting in the sink.

summary:
[reference generation] The target video presents a 12-second commercial-style cinematic sequence where <Subject 1> interacts with <Subject 2> in a modern bathroom setting referenced by <Video 1>.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2]): fully_preserved - Maintaining the blonde hair and black sweater appearance.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2]): fully_preserved - Preserving the specific coral color and box design.
<Video 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2]): fully_preserved - Replicating the black sink, white tiles, and smartphone placement.

detailed_description:
The video showcases a high-end fashion product demonstration with a cinematic, realistic look, featuring natural sunlight and sharp focus.

[Shot 1] The video begins with a static composition where the scene is established from the perspective of <Video 1>. <Subject 1> is seen from a side-rear angle, positioned on the right side of the frame. In the center, a smartphone vibrates and ripples the water inside the black granite sink. <Subject 1> holds <Subject 2> with a steady hand, staring at it with a calm expression, effectively ignoring the phone. The camera performs a smooth Push In with small amplitude at a slow speed, gradually focusing on the coral box. The lighting is bright, casting distinct shadows on the white subway tiles.

[Shot 2] At 00:06.000, the shot cuts to a tighter close-up of <Subject 1>'s hand and the lipstick. <Subject 1> performs an action of twisting the metallic base of the tube, causing the coral lipstick bullet to rise upward. She slowly rotates the tube in the sunlight, creating a glossy sheen on the product. The camera executes a gradual Push In at a slow speed, moving closer to the lipstick to highlight its texture and color. The environment remains the same bathroom setting from <Video 1>, maintaining visual continuity.

overall_soundscape:
Faint bathroom ambience and the rhythmic electronic buzzing of a vibrating smartphone dominate the first half. Subtle mechanical clicks and the wet sound of the lipstick tube being twisted are captured in the second half.
